title: Measure Appointment Cancellations and the Measure Fee Refund — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
A Ridgeline Installation Services customer may cancel a booked measure at any time before it takes place, by their own confirmation. The contract is then cancelled with the reason "measure cancelled".

## Refund rule

The measure fee is refunded in full, as one refund line with the reason "measure cancelled" referencing the measure fee payment, when both of the following hold:

1. the program's measure fee is refundable on cancellation; and
2. the cancellation is made at least the program's cancellation-notice hours before the start of the measure appointment.

Hours are counted as full 60-minute periods back from the appointment start, and a cancellation made exactly the notice hours before the start still qualifies. A cancellation made with less notice, or a missed appointment, forfeits the fee and no refund posts. Moving the measure to another date is not a cancellation and keeps the fee paid.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical appointment at 14:00 on a Thursday, 24-hour notice, refundable fee)

| Cancellation made | Full hours of notice | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 09:00 | 29 | yes, in full |
| Wednesday 14:00 | 24, exactly the notice | yes, in full |
| Wednesday 14:30 | 23 (23 hours 30 minutes is not a 24th full hour) | no, fee forfeited |
| Thursday 08:00 | 6 | no, fee forfeited |
| Not cancelled, customer absent at the measure | not a cancellation | no, fee forfeited |
| Appointment moved to the following week | not a cancellation | fee stays paid |

## Basis questions answered

**What happens on a program that does not refund the measure fee?** The second condition alone is not enough; the refund requires the program's fee to be refundable on cancellation. The programs with a free consultation have no fee to refund.

**Does a refund ever post without the customer's confirmation of the cancellation?** The cancellation itself is made by the customer's own confirmation; the refund follows the cancellation.
